Summed to county level over the common 2015-2019 window, Kiama totals 29,015 against Boru's 22,172 - Boru is 24% lower overall and lower in 30 of the 35 counties with cases, exactly as expected of a source that discards records with unresolved sub-county. The comparison CONFIRMS both the usability of Boru's positives and the unusability of its zeros. THE POSITIVES AGREE: Kiambu 323 vs 322, Kisumu 165 vs 163, Siaya 862 vs 848, Tana River 1,349 vs 1,310, Nakuru 449 vs 412. ONE YEAR-ASSIGNMENT DISAGREEMENT worth knowing: North Horr (Marsabit) carries 365 cases in Boru's 2020 column and the same 365 inside Kiama's Jan 2015 - Dec 2019 cumulative.
